name: Kansas City International Airport
before:
Kansas City's airport, 15 miles north west of downtown in Platte County, and completely rebuilt. A new terminal complex opened in 2023, replacing the one that had been there since the airport opened in 1972.

The new building is a single terminal with 40 gates across two concourses, 13 in A and 27 in B. International arrivals without pre-clearance are handled at gates A12, A14 and A16. There is a seven storey car park attached with 6,219 spaces and electric vehicle charging.

It flies non-stop to 47 airports, including Cancún, Montego Bay and San José del Cabo.

Ground transport is the weak point. There is an hourly public bus from downtown and several private shared shuttles out to regional cities such as Columbia, Topeka and Lawrence, but no rail link. Plans for one go back to the 1960s, and the city commissioned fresh proposals ahead of the 2026 World Cup.

Worth a look while waiting: the terminal carries commissioned work by 28 artists, paid for through a percent for art programme.
after:
Kansas City's airport, north west of downtown in Platte County. A new single terminal opened in 2023, replacing the terminals in use since the airport opened in 1972.

The terminal has two concourses, A and B, with a US customs facility for international arrivals. A seven-storey car park stands across from it. The FAA's preliminary figures show about 5.6 million passengers boarding flights here in 2025.

Ground transport is the weak point. RideKC's route 229 bus runs hourly between the terminal and downtown Kansas City, a ride of just under an hour. There is no rail link.

Worth a look while waiting: the terminal carries commissioned work by 28 artists, paid for through a percent for art programme.

claims.claim: 15 miles from downtown
claims.why: The sources do not agree on the figure: Wikipedia says 15 miles (24 km), the FAA record 15 nautical miles (about 17 statute miles, 28 km); the coordinates give 15.7 miles (25.3 km) in a straight line. The operator's site could not be read. Figure dropped, direction kept; the bus time now gives a sense of the distance.

claims.claim: completely rebuilt
claims.why: Overstated: the terminal was replaced in 2023; nothing says the airfield was rebuilt.

opinion.text: Ground transport is the weak point.
opinion.why: The old text's framing, kept. The facts after it are sourced (one hourly RideKC route, just under an hour from downtown, no rail link), and KCUR's reporter reached the same view on 6 April 2026: 'World Cup tourists, and locals, need better options'.
